# 0G Documentation

> 0G is the trust layer for AI. It combines private compute, encrypted storage, and an AI-native EVM L1 chain in one stack where AI work, from inference to agent actions, is verified and audited.

This is the index of the technical documentation for 0G at https://docs.0g.ai, following the llmstxt.org standard. Sections mirror the site navigation. Every link points at the markdown version of a page; append .md to any docs URL to get that page as markdown, and use https://docs.0g.ai/llms-full.txt for the whole corpus in one file.

Not here: what 0G is as a project and company is at https://0g.ai/llms.txt; the builder-focused overview, tools and funding are at https://build.0g.ai/llms.txt; how to buy, bridge or withdraw the 0G token is at https://get.0g.ai/llms.txt.

## Start here

- [0G Documentation](https://docs.0g.ai/index.md): Developer documentation for 0G (Zero Gravity), the trust layer for AI: private compute, encrypted storage, data availability, and an AI-native L1.
- [AI Coding Context](https://docs.0g.ai/ai-context.md): Comprehensive 0G infrastructure context for AI coding assistants, including network configs, contract addresses, and SDK examples.

## Introduction

- [Understanding 0G](https://docs.0g.ai/introduction/understanding-0g.md): Learn what 0G (Zero Gravity) is — the first decentralized AI L1 chain with modular storage, compute, data availability, and the native 0G token.
- [Vision & Mission](https://docs.0g.ai/introduction/vision-mission.md): 0G's mission is to make AI a public good through decentralized infrastructure — enabling open, censorship-resistant, and user-owned AI development.
- [How to Get 0G Token](https://docs.0g.ai/introduction/how-to-get-0g.md): Learn how to buy, bridge, and swap 0G tokens through exchanges, cross-chain bridges, and 0G Hub. Includes wallet setup and supported trading pairs.

## Concepts

- [0G Chain](https://docs.0g.ai/concepts/chain.md): 0G Chain is an EVM-compatible L1 built for AI workloads, with sub-second finality for AI applications, DeFi, and on-chain agents.
- [0G Compute Network](https://docs.0g.ai/concepts/compute.md): 0G Compute Network is a decentralized GPU marketplace for AI inference, fine-tuning, and model training — pay only for what you use.
- [0G Storage](https://docs.0g.ai/concepts/storage.md): 0G Storage is a decentralized storage network for massive AI datasets: 10-100x cheaper, high throughput, and no vendor lock-in.
- [0G DA](https://docs.0g.ai/concepts/da.md): 0G DA keeps blockchain data accessible, powering rollups, gaming chains, and high-frequency trading with scalable data availability.
- [AI Alignment Nodes](https://docs.0g.ai/concepts/ai-alignment.md): Discover how 0G AI Alignment Nodes monitor AI systems, ensure safe behavior, and provide decentralized oversight for trustworthy AI operations.
- [Agentic ID](https://docs.0g.ai/concepts/agentic-id.md): Agentic IDs (formerly INFTs) are a token standard for AI agent ownership, with encrypted intelligence, secure transfers, and ERC-7857.
- [DePIN Providers](https://docs.0g.ai/concepts/depin.md): Explore how 0G integrates DePIN providers like io.net and Aethir for cost-effective, decentralized GPU computing for AI workloads.

## Developer Hub

- [Getting Started](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/getting-started.md): Get started building on 0G — quickstart guides for storage, compute, data availability, and deploying smart contracts on the 0G Chain.
- [0G Galileo Testnet](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/testnet/testnet-overview.md): 0G Galileo Testnet network details including Chain ID, RPC endpoints, faucet access, contract addresses, and wallet setup.
- [Mainnet Overview](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/mainnet/mainnet-overview.md): 0G Mainnet network details including Chain ID, RPC endpoints, contract addresses, and wallet setup for production deployments.

## Developer Hub / Building on 0G

- [Building on 0G](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/introduction.md): Get started building on 0G. Add storage, compute, and DA services to any EVM, non-EVM, or Web2 application without migration.

## Developer Hub / Building on 0G / 0G Chain

- [Deploy Contracts on 0G Chain](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/contracts-on-0g/deploy-contracts.md): Deploy and verify smart contracts on 0G Chain using Hardhat, Foundry, or Truffle. Includes EVM configuration, network setup, and precompile access.
- [Staking Interfaces](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/contracts-on-0g/staking-interfaces.md): 0G Chain staking smart contract interfaces for validators and delegators. Covers validator creation, delegation, rewards, and initialization guide.
- [Validator Contract Functions](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/contracts-on-0g/validator-contract-functions.md): Function reference for 0G Chain validator contracts: delegations, rewards, commission, and withdrawal management.
- [0G Token Addresses](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/contracts-on-0g/token-addresses.md): Official contract addresses for the 0G token: W0G on 0G Mainnet, W0G bridged with Chainlink CCIP on Ethereum, Base, Solana and Robinhood Chain, and the bridged 0G token on Ethereum and BNB Chain.

## Developer Hub / Building on 0G / 0G Chain / Precompiles

- [0G Chain Precompiles](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/contracts-on-0g/precompiles/precompiles-overview.md): Overview of 0G Chain precompiled contracts including DASigners and Wrapped0GBase. Gas-efficient native operations for DA and DeFi integration.
- [DASigners](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/contracts-on-0g/precompiles/precompiles-dasigners.md): DASigners precompile reference for 0G Chain. Register signers, query quorums and epochs, and verify data availability via EVM smart contract calls.
- [Wrapped 0G Base](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/contracts-on-0g/precompiles/precompiles-wrappedogbase.md): Wrapped0GBase precompile for 0G Chain. Wrap and unwrap native 0G tokens as ERC20 with quota-based mint and burn functions for DeFi compatibility.

## Developer Hub / Building on 0G / 0G Chain / Indexing

- [Goldsky Subgraphs](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/indexing/goldsky.md): Index 0G Chain data with Goldsky subgraphs and Mirror streaming. Query onchain data via GraphQL or stream it directly to your database.

## Developer Hub / Building on 0G / 0G Compute

- [0G Compute Overview](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/overview.md): Overview of the 0G Compute Network — a decentralized GPU marketplace for affordable AI inference, fine-tuning, and verifiable computation.

## Developer Hub / Building on 0G / 0G Compute / For Developers / Router

- [0G Compute Router](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/overview.md): A single OpenAI-compatible endpoint for every model on the 0G Compute Network. No SDK, no wallet keys — just an API key.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/quickstart.md): Four steps from zero to your first inference request.
- [Principles](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/principles.md): The design choices behind the Router — API compatibility, on-chain settlement, failover, and verifiable execution.
- [Models](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/models.md): Browse the live model catalog — pricing, context window, capabilities, and provider count.
- [Provider Routing](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/routing.md): Control which provider serves your request — by latency, price, or specific on-chain address — via X-0G-Provider-* request headers.
- [Authentication](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/authentication.md): API keys (sk-) call models; management keys (mk-) administer your account. Send either in the Authorization header.
- [Data Privacy & Zero Data Retention](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/privacy.md): What the 0G Compute Router retains, what it never sees, and how to enforce sealed (TeeML-only) inference per API key or per request.
- [Deposits & Billing](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/account/deposits.md): Deposit 0G tokens to the shared 0G Payment Layer, check your balance, and see how per-request cost is calculated.
- [Rate Limits](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/rate-limits.md): How the Router throttles requests, what headers you'll see, and how to handle 429 responses.
- [Errors](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/errors.md): HTTP status codes and error shapes returned by the Router.
- [Router vs Direct](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/comparison.md): Which integration path to pick — Router gateway or Direct with wallet signing.
- [Router FAQ](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/faq.md): Frequently asked questions about the 0G Compute Router.

## Developer Hub / Building on 0G / 0G Compute / For Developers / Router / Features

- [Chat Completions](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/features/chat-completions.md): OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions with streaming, tool calling, JSON mode, and reasoning tokens.
- [Image Generation](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/features/image-generation.md): Generate images on 0G Compute via synchronous (OpenAI-compatible) or asynchronous submit-and-poll endpoints.
- [Audio Transcription](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/features/audio.md): Speech-to-text via the OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/transcriptions endpoint.
- [Verifiable Execution](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/features/verifiable-execution.md): Opt-in TEE signature verification for Router responses. Ask the Router to synchronously verify that a response came from an attested TEE provider.

## Developer Hub / Building on 0G / 0G Compute / For Developers / Router / Clients & Dev Tools

- [0gpc CLI](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/clients/0gpc-cli.md): Connect Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, or Hermes Agent to the 0G Compute Router with one command — preview every change, undo any time.
- [Claude Code](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/router/clients/claude-code.md): Configure Claude Code to run on the 0G Compute Router.

## Developer Hub / Building on 0G / 0G Compute / For Developers / Direct

- [Inference](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/inference.md): Run inference on 0G Compute via the Direct path: connect to providers, manage sub-accounts, and sign requests with your wallet.
- [Fine-tuning](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/fine-tuning.md): Fine-tune AI models on 0G Compute Network. Prepare datasets, configure training, monitor tasks, and deploy LoRA adapters using the CLI.
- [Account](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/account-management.md): Main account and per-provider sub-accounts for 0G Compute SDK services. Deposit, transfer, refund, and withdraw via Web UI, CLI, or SDK.

## Developer Hub / Building on 0G / 0G Compute / For Providers

- [Inference Provider](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/inference-provider.md): Set up an inference provider on 0G Compute Network. Monetize GPUs with TEE verification, automated billing, and OpenAI-compatible service endpoints.
- [Fine-tuning Provider](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/compute-network/fine-tuning-provider.md): Become a fine-tuning provider on 0G Compute Network. Set up TEE-secured GPU infrastructure with Docker and Intel TDX for model training services.

## Developer Hub / Building on 0G / 0G Storage

- [Storage SDK](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/storage/sdk.md): Integrate 0G decentralized storage using Go and TypeScript SDKs. Upload, download, and manage files with key-value storage and browser support.
- [Storage CLI](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/storage/storage-cli.md): Use the 0G Storage CLI to upload, download, and manage files and directories. Includes KV operations, REST API gateway, and automation examples.

## Developer Hub / Building on 0G / 0G DA

- [DA Client Nodes](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/da-integration.md): Set up 0G DA Client, Encoder, and Retriever nodes. Includes hardware requirements, Docker installation, and configuration reference.
- [Technical Deep Dive](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/da-deep-dive.md): Technical deep dive into 0G DA architecture covering erasure encoding, KZG commitments, DA sampling, difficulty adjustment, and the economic model.

## Developer Hub / Building on 0G / 0G DA / Rollups and Appchains

- [OP Stack on 0G DA](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/rollups-and-appchains/op-stack-on-0g-da.md): Deploy an OP Stack rollup using 0G DA for data availability. Full guide covering DA server setup, contract deployment, and L2 configuration.
- [Arbitrum Nitro on 0G DA](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/rollups-and-appchains/arbitrum-nitro-on-0g-da.md): Run an Arbitrum Nitro rollup with 0G DA for cost-effective data availability. Includes DA provider integration and setup prerequisites.

## Developer Hub / Building on 0G / Agentic IDs

- [Agentic ID Overview](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/agentic-id/overview.md): Developer overview of Agentic IDs for tokenizing AI agents: ERC-7857, secure transfers, encryption, and 0G infrastructure integration.
- [Agentic ID Integration Guide](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/agentic-id/integration.md): Build Agentic IDs on 0G: deploy contracts, manage encrypted AI metadata, implement secure transfers, and build AI agent marketplaces.
- [ERC-7857 Standard](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/agentic-id/erc7857.md): ERC-7857 specification for encrypted NFT metadata: transfer architecture, TEE and ZKP oracle implementations, and security guidelines.
- [ERC-8004 Trustless Agents](https://docs.0g.ai/developer-hub/building-on-0g/agentic-id/erc8004.md): 0G supports ERC-8004, the Trustless Agent standard, so agents on 0G are discoverable and interoperable. Includes registry addresses and 8004scan.

## Run a Node

- [Running a 0G Node](https://docs.0g.ai/run-a-node/overview.md): Overview of running nodes on the 0G network — validator, storage, DA, and archival nodes. Earn rewards by securing the network.
- [Validator Node](https://docs.0g.ai/run-a-node/validator-node.md): Guide to running a 0G validator node — secure the network, process transactions, and earn rewards by staking 0G tokens.
- [Migrating from geth to reth](https://docs.0g.ai/run-a-node/migrate-geth-to-reth.md): Run a 0G node with reth: geth vs reth comparison, a fresh reth setup, and a step-by-step geth to reth migration.
- [Storage Node](https://docs.0g.ai/run-a-node/storage-node.md): Complete guide to running a 0G storage node, including hardware requirements, configuration, sharding, and Storage KV setup.
- [Data Availability Node](https://docs.0g.ai/run-a-node/da-node.md): Step-by-step guide to setting up a 0G Data Availability node, including Docker and source builds, BLS key generation, and signer registration.
- [Archival Node](https://docs.0g.ai/run-a-node/archival-node.md): Guide to running a 0G archival node for complete historical blockchain data storage, including setup and deployment steps.
- [Community Docker Repository](https://docs.0g.ai/run-a-node/community-docker-repo.md): Community-maintained Docker images for running 0G nodes, including validator and DA node containers from third-party contributors.
